sections.section_title: RCC AHB4 peripheral sleep clock register (RCC_AHB4LPENR)
sections.text_helper: Section 9.8.24 "RCC AHB4 peripheral sleep clock register (RCC_AHB4LPENR)" in chapter 9 (Reset and clock control (RCC)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 308.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x0BC
Reset value: 0x00100000
Bits 31:21 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 20 XSPI1LPEN: XSPI1 clock enable during sleep mode
Set and reset by software.
0: XSPI1 clock disabled during sleep mode
1: XSPI1 clock enabled during sleep mode (default after reset)
Bits 19:0 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
